name: com.innov8tif.okaydoc.activity.MyKadDetectionActivity
description: OkayDoc (Innov8tif document-authenticity SDK) opens the camera for a still-image or video check of a Malaysian MyKad. It guides card framing and checks the captured card before returning a result.
disableEffect: The app cannot run OkayDoc Malaysian identity-card authenticity checks if this screen is disabled.
